evidence.decision: Chooses family-tailored timely information versus launcher fallback and meaningful percentage/range gauge forms, with realistic timeline budgets.
evidence.artifact: Requires family/data/timeline/private/placeholder/destination specification plus actual variant or deep-link artifact.
evidence.transformation: Transit example replaces one static full-color logo and per-second reload assumption with family-specific departures, timeline updates and tint/private placeholders.
evidence.verification: Checks slot fit, tint, long/no/stale data and tap identity; unsupported template claims, unlimited reloads and Always On leaks fail.
evidence.applicability: Separates WidgetKit/legacy ClockKit, preserves unresolved inline dimension typo and Watch-only scope, without claiming wrist readability from files.
evidence.handoffs: Widgets supplies common strategy, Gauges supplies range semantics and Watch faces supplies curated configurations.
evidence.distinctiveness: Face-slot families, distinct placeholder sizing and reload timelines distinguish complications from general widgets.
